primary_path.name: v2_native_compact_to_expanded_model
primary_path.summary: Train a compact V2-native model on the currently sourced V2 observation surface (224 dims for BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT, 215 dims for SOLUSDT). Expand inputs as operator-approved lanes light up. Validate after-cost edge in paper/shadow before any canary.
advantages: No policy architecture port required upfront.
Training-spec and evaluator authoring can start without live/canary approval; formal edge certification and any canary remain operator-gated.
limitations: Decision-match against legacy will be low initially (honest, not a failure).
Cannot predict outcomes that depend on external feeds until operator approves them.

secondary_path.name: legacy_parity_comparator_preservation
secondary_path.summary: Preserve the V2-vs-legacy comparator track for informational comparison only. Do not pursue 1911 parity autonomously.

next_automatable_tasks: Author the V2-native compact-to-expanded training spec under claude_worklog/final_readiness/v2_native_edge_proof/
Wire a paper-soak evaluator that emits rolling after-cost expectancy plus drawdown bounds
Route every training/evaluation artifact through Codex review on the existing self-healing controller + executive command center surface
Continue read-only V2-vs-legacy comparator (informational, not a gate)
Keep the executive command center, self-healing controller, report center, and remaining-dim queue current
operator_decisions_required: Approve the V2-native edge-proof gate (paper-only soak; no canary)
Set 10 numeric capital protection caps in capital_recovery_gate_model.json
Decide whether to start the legacy policy architecture port in parallel (optional)
Decide each external feed individually (token metrics, onchain BTC, onchain ETH, CCXT OHLCV, paid CoinAnk aggregator)
Approve the paper-edge certification threshold (min trade count, min after-cost expectancy, drawdown bounds)
Approve the V2-vs-legacy decision-match certification threshold (informational only)
